verdict.rationale: The official README lists "Debug issues and troubleshoot with natural language" as a core capability. It also documents on-demand debugging help when you mention @gemini-cli in GitHub issues and pull requests. The evidence is only a one-line feature claim, with no detailed workflow docs and no hands-on account of debugging sessions. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the debugging/troubleshooting workflow, independent hands-on corroboration of natural-language debugging quality
